posts.text:
Every payment, coin buy, new agent and safety refusal on three.ws/symphony becomes a synthesized note the moment it happens. It is a Labs experiment: the agent economy played live as music, with nothing prerecorded.

The notes all land on one minor-pentatonic scale, so a stream of unrelated events always harmonizes. Bigger money plays lower. Each agent hashes to its own motif, so one that comes back is recognizable by ear.

The reel has no sound, so watch the stage: one orb per note, placed left to right by the agent that caused it and up by pitch. Play opens on the last ten real events as an overture, then follows the live feed.
Under the stage, a ledger lists the real event behind every note. Mute any of the six voices, solo one agent so everything else drops out, or record up to a minute of it as a video with the sound.
